name: Woods Bali
description: is an upscale restaurant and café located in the Pererenan neighborhood of Bali, near Canggu, known for its Mediterranean-inspired menu, rustic wooden décor, and cozy garden atmosphere.
openingHours: Daily: 08:00 – 23:00 (food & drinks available; kitchen may pause 17:00–18:00)
priceRange: Approx. IDR 60.000 – 500.000 per person (coffee, pastries & small plates ~IDR 60.000–135.000; mains ~IDR 125.000–325.000; cocktails & drinks ~IDR 130.000–160.000)
